The promotion playoff was played by the winner of Group A, [[Talleres de Córdoba|Talleres (C)]] and the winner of Group B, [[Club Atlético Belgrano|Belgrano]]. The winning team was declared champion and was automatically promoted to [[1998–99 Argentine Primera División|Primera Division]]. The losing team joined in semifinals of the [[#Second Promotion Playoff|Second Promotion Playoff]]. In the series, nicknamed ''the final of the century'',[https://suquia.ar/deportes/talleres/a-24-anos-de-la-final-del-siglo-donde-talleres-vencia-a-belgrano-y-ascendia-a-primera A 24 años de la “Final del siglo”, donde Talleres vencía a Belgrano y ascendía a Primera] by Mario Celedón at Suquia.ar, 5 Jul 2022[https://www.perfil.com/noticias/cordoba/a-25-anos-de-la-final-del-siglo-entre-talleres-y-belgrano.phtml A 25 años de "la final del siglo" entre Talleres y Belgrano] on Perfil.com, 5 Jul 2023 Talleres 4–3 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] after both teams tied 2–2 on [[goal difference|aggregate]].[https://www.clubtalleres.com.ar/a-23-anos-del-ascenso-mas-apasionante-que-haya-vivido-talleres-y-el-futbol-de-cordoba/ A 23 años del ascenso más apasionante que haya vivido Talleres y el fútbol de Córdoba] at Talleres website === Match details === {{Football box |id = |date = 1 Jul 1998 |time = |event = Championship playoff |round = First leg |team1 = [[Talleres de Córdoba|Talleres (C)]] |score1 = 1 |team2 = [[Club Atlético Belgrano|Belgrano (C)]] |score2 = 0 |scorenote = |aet = |report = |goals1 = Zelaya {{goal|84}} |goals2 = |stadium = [[Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes|Estadio Olímpico]] |location = [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]] |attendance = 35,000 |referee = Daniel Giménez |penalties1 = |penaltyscore = |penalties2 = |size = |bg = }} ---- {{Football box |id = |date = 5 Jul 1998 |time = |event = |round = Second leg |team1 = [[Club Atlético Belgrano|Belgrano (C)]] |score1 = 2 |team2 = [[Talleres de Córdoba|Talleres (C)]] |score2 = 1 |scorenote = (3–4 p) |aet = yes |report = [https://canalshowsport.com.ar/hace-25-anos-talleres-derrotaba-a-belgrano-y-se-quedaba-con-el-ascenso/ Report] |goals1 = Carnero {{goal|79}}
